damage_symptoms: Hopper burn: yellowing and drying of plants in circular patches
management: Avoid excess nitrogen, use resistant varieties, encourage natural predators like spiders and mirid bugs.

damage_symptoms: Dead heart in vegetative stage, white ear head at reproductive stage
management: Use pheromone traps, remove and destroy affected tillers, encourage egg-parasitoid release (Trichogramma).

damage_symptoms: Yellowing, sooty mould from honeydew, transmits leaf curl viruses
management: Use yellow sticky traps, avoid excess nitrogen, encourage natural predators; rotate non-host crops.

damage_symptoms: Window-pane feeding damage on young leaves, ragged holes on whorl leaves
management: Scout fields regularly, hand-pick egg masses, encourage natural enemies, use pheromone traps for monitoring.

damage_symptoms: Circular holes bored into pods/flowers, larval frass visible
management: Deploy pheromone traps, encourage bird perches, avoid continuous monoculture.

damage_symptoms: Silvery streaks on leaves, curling and crinkling of young leaves
management: Use blue sticky traps, avoid moisture stress, encourage predatory mites and bugs.
